title: Complexity of Quadratic Bosonic Hamiltonian Simulation: BQP-Completeness and PostBQP-Hardness
summary: The computational complexity of simulating the dynamics of physical quantum systems is a central question at the interface of quantum physics and computer science. In this work, we address this question for the simulation of exponentially large bosonic Hamiltonians with quadratic interactions. We present two results: First, we introduce a broad class of quadratic bosonic problems for which we prove that they are BQP-complete.
